findings.resolution: Read RP2040 sections 2.8.4 and 2.15.3: UF2 can load RAM; 133 MHz covers all PVT, 200 MHz requires elevated DVDD. Corrected absolute flash claim and clock row. Wording concerns power loss, not an unsupported claim that every reset destroys SRAM.

Raspberry Pi describes no built-in flash and states code can run from SRAM; it identifies 133 MHz as the RP2040 core speed.
